title: kith-jmap: no MSRV set in workspace or per-crate Cargo.toml
description: workspace Cargo.toml has no rust-version field; neither do crates/kith-jmap, crates/kith-events, or crates/kith-tslocal per-crate manifests. Without an MSRV: CI cannot enforce a minimum compiler version; contributors can silently introduce syntax that breaks users on older toolchains. axum 0.8 requires Rust 1.75+ and hyper 1.x requires 1.70+. Add rust-version = "1.75" (or determined real floor) to [workspace.package].
